signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use your Forge account. New here? Request a sign-in link and we'll create one for you.
signIn.magicLead: We'll email a link that signs you in. Open it on this phone, or paste it below.
signIn.magicSent: Check {email}. The link is valid for 15 minutes.
signIn.pasteLabel: Paste the link from the email
signIn.invalidLink: That doesn't look like a Forge sign-in link.
signIn.linkFailed: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Name one below and describe what to build.
projects.noWorkspace: You're not a member of any workspace.

chat.placeholder: Describe what to build or change…
chat.planModeHint: Review the plan before Forge builds
chat.empty: Tell Forge what to make: an app, a site, an image, a video, a deck or an agent.
chat.question: Forge needs one answer
chat.approvalHint: Approve this in the Forge web app.
chat.spendCap: This would exceed your spend cap. Raise it in the web app to continue.
chat.notConfigured: This Forge server isn't fully configured yet: {message}

voice.title: Voice prompt
voice.lead: Tap once to start, and again when you're done.
voice.transcriptPlaceholder: Your words appear here as you speak. You can edit them before sending.
voice.permissionDenied: Forge needs microphone access to hear your prompt. Allow it in Settings.
voice.unavailable: Live transcription isn't available on this server. Type your prompt instead.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.empty: No meetings yet. Record an in-person meeting and Forge turns it into a spec.
meetings.uploadLocal: Saved on this phone, waiting for network
meetings.uploadExpired: The server dropped this upload. Upload it again from the start.
meetings.removeConfirm: Delete this recording from the phone? It hasn't been uploaded.
meetings.signInToUpload: Sign in again to continue uploading.

record.title: Record meeting
record.consentBody: Recording people without telling them is not OK and may be illegal. Say out loud that the meeting is recorded and transcribed by Forge, and stop if anyone objects.
record.consentCheck: Everyone present knows this meeting is being recorded
record.keepOpen: Keep Forge open, or let it run in the background. The screen stays on while recording.
record.permissionDenied: Forge needs microphone access to record. Allow it in Settings.
record.saved: Saved. Uploading in the background — you can leave this screen.
record.leaveBody: Stop the recording and upload it before leaving?

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.processing: Forge is transcribing and extracting requirements. This screen updates by itself.
meeting.chooseProjectHint: The spec becomes a task in this project.
meeting.noProjects: Create a project first, then come back to build this spec.
meeting.deleteConfirm: Delete the recording, transcript and spec permanently?

preview.title: Preview
preview.none: No preview yet. Forge posts one when a build has something to show.
preview.expoLead: Scan with the camera (iOS) or Expo Go (Android), or open it directly on this phone.
preview.noExpoGo: Install Expo Go from the App Store or Google Play, then try again.
preview.blocked: Blocked a link to a non-web address.
preview.loadFailed: The preview didn't load. The sandbox may be asleep — reload in a moment.

errors.network: Can't reach Forge. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
